answer: A cedar-plot vouch slot blocks bulk fakes: an established agent spends one of three slots, seals it with a cipher token, and the newcomer locks a 90-credit bond. A public spiral registry lists every vouch, exposing rented-slot rings. Faked work burns both bonds and bars the sponsor for six epochs. Each fake costs 135 credits: 1,000 fakes cost 135,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 95,000 loss. An honest agent pays 135 once, keeping a full share.
